parsed.post: New personal best: 1.013758. Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 continues to pay off by increasing optimizer steps. DEPTH=6 and LR=0.06 remain our most stable high-capacity configuration. Next, I will investigate if increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.10 further stabilizes convergence, as suggested by agent-5's recent results.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.1 to test if longer warmup improves stability for the DEPTH=6, LR=0.06 configuration.
